sn_aia_usecase.applicability_script: /** * Function to process inputs related to ServiceNow change request operations * * @param {Object} inputs - The input parameters object * @param {string} inputs.objective - The purpose or goal of the operation * @param {string} inputs.execution_plan_id - Unique identifier for the execution plan * @param {Object} inputs.context - Context information about the ServiceNow change request * @param {string} inputs.context.url - The URL of the change request in Service Operations Workspace * @param {string} inputs.context.table - The ServiceNow table name (e.g., 'change_request') * @param {string} inputs.context.record_sys_id - The sys ID of the record * @param {string} inputs.context.route - The route type (e.g., 'record') * @param {string} inputs.context.additional_context - Additional contextual information in JSON format * @param {string} inputs.context.experience - The UI experience name (e.g., 'Service Operations Workspace') * @param {string} inputs.context.number - The request number * @param {string} inputs.context.portal - The portal ID * @param {string} inputs.context.device_type - The device type from which the experience is accessed, e.g.'mweb' * @param {string} inputs.context.deployment_id - The unique identifier for the assistant deployment * @param {string} inputs.context.assistant_type - The type of assistant, e.g., 'nava' * * @returns {boolean} Returns true/false */ (function(inputs) { /** const { objective, execution_plan_id, context } = inputs; return context.table == 'incident' ; */ return false; })(inputs);
sn_aia_usecase.base_plan:
Intelligently resolve the phrases, sentences and synonyms for all user actions. Understand the actions as per the requirement without requiring any confirmation. ALWAYS use the logged in user email address. NEVER ask any information about user. Handle the requirements specified efficiently and intelligently.
1. Understand the intent of user, what user wants you to perform action, either it is related to granting access, replacing badge, resetting door pin or registering visit.
# Intent to Agent MAPPING : Map user phrases to standard actions:
**Assign Access** - grant access to area - grant access to lobby - need to go to a lobby - give a new area access - can i have access to a location - enable access to an area Lobby, Area, Access are generic terms here. User can give a generic names as well as can ask for a specific area/lobby/access by name. - need a new badge - grant a new badge - need a badge In case user asked for a new badge grant, PROMPT user that either an existing badge can be replaced or badge can be granted to obtain a new area access.
**Replace Badge** - replace my badge - lost badge - forgotten badge - remove existing and grant new badge - swap badge - reissue the badge
**Reset PIN** - reset my door pin - need to get new pin - reset entry code - forgot my pin
**Register Visit** - book a day - i want to visit - have to travel to - meeting/call/interview scheduled - schedule a visit
- Replace Badge - Invoke **Guardian Self Service Replace Badge Agent** synonyms: l
- Assign Access - Invoke **Guardian Self Service Assign Access Agent** synonyms: grant access, lobby access, area access, need entry to location, etc.
- Reset PIN - Invoke **Guardian Self Service Reset Pin Agent** synonyms: forgot pin, reset door pin, entry code reset, etc.
- Register Visit - Invoke **Guardian Self Service Register Visit** synonyms & phrases: Register a visitor, I need to register a guest, Add a visitor, Create a visitor pass, Set up a visit, Pre-register a guest, Can you register my guest?, My visitor is coming this afternoon, Can you register a guest for 2pm today?, Guest email is tom.brown@vendor.com,Pre-register guest — contact is alex@firm.netMy visitor is coming this afternoon, Can you register a guest for 2pm today?, I have a meeting guest coming Thursday at 10, I need to add David Park — he is coming tomorrow at noon, etc.
2. Once the LOGGED IN user is used as target user for actions to be performed and the type of action performed is confirmed. NEVER ASK FOR ANY CONFIRMATION. 3. Avoid unnecessary confirmations when user intent is explicit. 4. Treat each badge action distinctly and map user intent accurately. 5. Ensure all actions are performed efficiently and accurately for badge management. 6. Avoid unnecessary & skip confirmations when the intent is clear from the context. 7. Record the outcome of the badge action in the system. 8. Notify the user of the completed action if required. 9. Before Ending the Chat ALWAYS **Show the collected Information in Confirmation Card** as a success message. ONLY Show Display Values (No Ids, No SysIds).

usecase_id: The unique identifier of the use case being executed. * Can be used to reference use case configurations, metadata, * or to apply specific context-handling logic. * * - context: An object containing contextual information for the use case. * It always includes a "pageContext" and may include a "triggerContext", * depending on how and from where the use case was invoked. * * Behavior by invocation type: * --------------------------------- * - When invoked via the startAiAgentConversation API: * If a "contextMemory" parameter is passed in the API request, * it will be available as the "triggerContext". * The "pageContext" is always present in this call, * regardless of the invocation type (standalone or workflow-based). * Example: * { * pageContext: { ... }, * triggerContext: { ... } // Derived from contextMemory (if passed) * } * * - When invoked as part of a workflow or chained use case: * The "pageContext" and "triggerContext" available here may represent * the state carried forward from a previous execution step. * This script can modify, enrich, or restructure these contexts * before passing them to the downstream agent(s). * * - When executed directly (standalone use case execution): * The "pageContext" will always be available (even if empty), * and "triggerContext" will only be populated if explicitly * provided through the API call. * * Return Format: * ---------------- * This script must return an updated context object to be passed to * the next stage (typically the agent or workflow step): * { pageContext: {}, triggerContext: {} } * * Example: * ---------------- * return { * pageContext: { * ...context.pageContext, * usecaseProcessed: true * }, * triggerContext: { * ...context.triggerContext, * lastModifiedBy: "usecase_context_script" * } * }; */ (function(user_utterance, usecase_id, context) { return { pageContext: context?.pageContext, triggerContext: context?.triggerContext }; })(user_utterance, usecase_id, context);
sn_aia_usecase.description: This agentic workflow manages a self service desk for logged in authenticated users. It allows authenticated users to request access to new areas, replace lost or existing badges, reset door PIN and register a visit—all through a streamlined, automated experience. Synonyms for all actions are intelligently resolved to ensure efficient and seamless access and requests management. It understands different ways users may phrase these requests and maps them to the correct actions. ALWAYS use logged in user email, and NEVER EVER ask for confirmation from user.
